content.summary: The integrated manuscript preserves the inspected acyclic proof interfaces and now states the returned-tree limitation accurately. Independent bounded checks support the hub-deletion and star-support deductions. No new required revision arose; the essential external H27 provenance gap and local shared-builder dependence remain, and this is not whole-proof certification.

findings.statement: H27 remains essential and locally unreconstructed. The root-tree discrepancy further limits repository-absence evidence; it neither authenticates the historical computation nor demonstrates a mathematical counterexample.
findings.disposition: Section 2 and the superseding tree addendum preserve this boundary. My earlier reference to the returned listing must not be read as verified repository completeness.

findings.statement: Committed fresh replays cover three R15 trees and one D18 model, with specified corruption controls; they do not establish every ordinary reduction or model row.
findings.disposition: I inspected their manifests/results, without rerunning them. Retain the shared-builder, imported-theorem and partial-Lean qualifications in Sections 3 and 7.

revisions.action: Compared manuscript versions and checked Section 3 against my committed resolutions.
revisions.result: N[max], its universal actual-member quantifier and the N43 anchor remain explicit; the earlier repair stays resolved.

revisions.action: Checked the new author response, retained source bytes and revised qualification.
revisions.result: The absence claim is now limited to the returned listing. The unresolved source-to-run assurance gap remains preserved.

checks.method: Independently serialized Git trees from the preserved recursive response using standard-library SHA1; confirmed both frozen round hashes.
checks.observation: The root reconstructs as 0a3e3838650fc981133940e798c9d220140e785e, differing from reported d4d5723267c662291efdadfa6e7061d919e76fa9; all 18 subordinate trees match. The manuscript correctly avoids inferring repository-wide absence or a cause.

checks.method: Read the integrated manuscript, global composition, cap15 assembly and superseding direct-Jin argument.
checks.observation: D20/D19 precede the cap18 package. Cap15 establishes universal N<=43 before the graph step; exact rho=7 classification in NO44 does not require the later rho<=6 exclusion. The final rho<=6, rho=7, rho=8 cases exhaust the complete degree15 link. Direct Jin replaces only the older image-reduction introduction.

checks.method: Read LOW15-R15-hub-deletion-exclusion.md, independently enumerated triangle-plus-path three-covers and bounded scalar possibilities.
checks.observation: The only three-covers are special hub 0 plus a triad pair, validating the B4 equality guard while retaining p0i. No ordered deficits 0<=a<=b<=c<=8, Y>=0 and t>=0 satisfy Y+3t<=8, Y+t>=1+b+c and Y+3<=2a+b. Only the three surviving actual anchors are used.

checks.method: Read LOW15-A3-star-fibre-reduction.md; independently checked all 266 deviation profiles and necessary positive star-support configurations.
checks.observation: All 32 nonempty independent supports lie in cyclic three-windows. The 392 feasible nonindependent profile/endpoint configurations use exactly eight rotated four-windows, endpoint weights 1 or 2 and interior weights at least 4. Actual nonstar counts yield 10+t+r covers, hence requirements 11 or 12; no complete-blowup premise enters.
